auth.why: To create your search, store your claim packs and statuses, and bill the 15% contingency fee to your saved card after a confirmed recovery.

description: Finds unclaimed money held by the state in your name across all 50 states + DC. Builds per-state claim packs with the official portal link, step-by-step filing instructions, and a pre-filled cover sheet — you file, we never do. Contingency: 15% of recovered funds, charged only after you confirm the recovery. No charge otherwise.

proactive_triggers.description: A move is detected (mover confirmation or address-change signal). The connector pre-fills the old and new states and asks one question: your full legal name. One tap and claim packs are ready.

tools.description: List all 50 states + DC with their official unclaimed-property portal URLs
tools.name: list_states

tools.description: Start an unclaimed-property search: name, email, and states lived in. Returns per-state claim checklist.

dob.description: YYYY-MM-DD, optional; some states need it at filing

dob_consent.description: Must be true to store dob

tools.name: start_search

tools.description: Handle a fanned-out life event from the shared bus. A 'move' pre-fills the state checklist and returns the proactive nudge.
tools.name: handle_life_event

tools.description: The one-tap confirmation after a move nudge: supply the claimant's full legal name to activate a draft search.
tools.name: complete_search

tools.description: Get the claim pack for one state: portal link, filing steps, document checklist, pre-filled cover sheet.
tools.name: get_claim_pack

tools.description: Update a state's claim status: not_started, in_progress, filed, paid, denied.
tools.name: update_claim_status

tools.description: Set up billing: Stripe customer + SetupIntent for an off-session card save. States the exact fee before the card is saved.
tools.name: setup_billing

tools.description: Confirm a recovery and charge the 15% contingency fee off-session. Requires setup_billing first.

state.description: Optional: state the recovery came from

tools.name: confirm_recovery

webhooks.life_event_received: Fired when the shared life-event bus fans out an event to this connector (e.g. a move). The agent sends the proactive nudge from the response's user_message.
